pins.title: Foot Warmer for Bed: How to Warm Cold Feet Before You Fall Asleep
pins.subtitle: Warm up, then switch off
pins.description: It's 11 p.m. and your feet are still cold. Before you buy a foot warmer for bed, know this: for the hours you're asleep, ordinary socks are the simple answer. The electric options are before-sleep aids at most, so switch them off before you fall asleep. Have diabetes, reduced feeling in your feet, or a circulation condition? Read who should skip them first. Not medical advice. Read the full guide. #footwarmer #coldfeet #coldfeetinbed #bedtimeroutine #sleepsetup

pins.title: Foot Warmer for Bed: Under-Sheet Warmer vs Foot Pad vs Heated Socks
pins.subtitle: Three different ideas
pins.description: A foot warmer for bed can mean three different things. SpotWarm lies under the sheet at the foot of the bed. The Snailax KH-019F8 pad buttons into a foot warmer. ActionHeat 5V socks have no cord. All three are for before sleep: switch off before you fall asleep. We compare washing, cords, and shut-off timers. Not medical advice. See the full comparison. #footwarmer #heatedsocks #heatingpad #coldfeet #sleepsetup

pins.title: Can You Sleep With a Foot Warmer On? What to Know Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Two makers say don't
pins.description: Hoping to leave a foot warmer on once you're asleep? Don't plan on it. The Snailax manual and ActionHeat's care page both say not to use them while sleeping. The SpotWarm manual we read has no line allowing it and says never to leave it unattended when plugged in. An auto shut-off is a backup, not permission. Switch it off before you fall asleep. Not medical advice. Read before you buy. #footwarmer #heatedsocks #coldfeet #heatingpad #sleepsetup

pins.title: Foot Warmer for Bed: 8-Point Checklist Before You Plug It In
pins.subtitle: Follow your manual first
pins.description: Save this foot warmer checklist. 1) Read what your manual says about sleep. 2) Try ordinary socks first. 3) Start on the lowest setting. 4) Keep the cord out from between mattress and box spring. 5) Skip extension cords. 6) Don't stack heated products. 7) Smooth out folds. 8) Check your skin. Switch it off before you fall asleep. Not medical advice. Details in the guide. #footwarmer #coldfeet #bedtimeroutine #bedroomchecklist #sleepsetup
